correctness.rationale: Writing source and sink as vertex indicators, only identical or adjacent vertices contribute mixed covariance; yields sum_edges(q p^(d_u+d_v-1)+p q^(d_u+d_v-1))-sum_vertices(pq)^d. An explicit arm transplantation decreases branching excess and strictly improves the vertex term; remaining edge correction B_d is nonnegative by its signed difference. Iterate to unique path. The formula for P_n and n=2,3 boundary cases were checked directly. Independent exact orientation enumeration for every unlabeled tree n<=7 and p=1/3,1/2,2/5 matches both covariance and strict extremum. No lower extremizer is claimed.
residual_risks: Finite tree enumeration does not prove the path extremum for arbitrary n or real p; unrestricted result uses the arm-transplant inequalities.
Only the specified homogeneous bipartition-biased orientation model is proved.
